methodology.primary: Two baseline A/A captures, followed by five complete ABBA rounds. Each capture includes bench:formula, bench:formula:engines, spill admission/resize/read/bulk write, and unchanged ingest/scroll controls.
methodology.delta: Median of five B/A ratios. Each A or B is the mean of the two raw capture medians in its ABBA round. All four raw medians are retained.
methodology.noise: Absolute A/A percentage difference; no minimum noise floor and no automatic timer-floor exemption. Primary regression threshold is measured A/A noise plus three percentage points.
methodology.warmAttribution: Additional five ABBA rounds; formula probes use 20 warmup fixtures and 15 samples, spill probes use 50 warmups and 25 samples. Attribution does not erase primary regression flags.

rootCause.rangeReads: Sampled candidate LET recalculation spent 820/5048 samples in SheetData::kind_at and 790/5048 in SheetData::resolved_payload_at, functions absent from baseline hot samples. Literal reads repeatedly resolved the calculated overlay and larger accessors stopped inlining.
rootCause.resultWrites: Calculated errors lived in a separate derived_errors HashMap. Warm ABBA confirmed removed-sheet-ref +29.15% and error-propagation +11.22% before its removal.
rootCause.bulkReads: fill_window_cell dominated bulk window profiles. Inlining it into bulk loops reduced the focused Node profile from 0.523525 to 0.388589 ms/window (baseline 0.506964), without projection maintenance on result writes.

fixes: Borrow source kind/payload slices for dense literal range evaluation, preserving formula dependency evaluation, source precedence, unloaded-cell checks and recursion limits.
Decode literal source payloads directly and inline the hot kind accessor.
Encode FormulaError slots in the existing tagged calculated u64 payload, removing the separate error map, its allocation/hashing, its lifecycle maintenance and obsolete memory-budget accounting.
Inline resident cell projection into bulk window loops.
Retain Rust-only source commit/spill admission/recalculation ownership, source-independent derived values, source history, source obstruction and spill destination demand contracts.

measuredExceptions.justification: Fresh-process medians are bimodal (roughly 0.66–13.49 ms on the candidate); 20 warmup fixtures and 15 samples per process remove the aggregate slowdown. [INFERENCE] WASM tiering / cold-process timing variance, not sustained recalculation overhead.
measuredExceptions.disposition: Measured exception for maintainer review; primary regression flag retained.

measuredExceptions.justification: The median paired absolute increase is 0.001349 ms (1.349 microseconds). A separate five-round ABBA with the same exported fresh-fixture factory, 20 warmups and 15 samples, is within its measured A/A noise plus three points; no timer-floor exemption was applied to the primary gate.
measuredExceptions.disposition: Measured exception for maintainer review; primary regression flag retained.

measuredExceptions.justification: The primary median paired absolute increase is 0.044456 ms for 1000 formulas. An equivalent fresh-fixture default-engine five-round ABBA after 20 warmups is within its measured A/A noise plus three points. [INFERENCE] cold-process / short-sample variance.
measuredExceptions.disposition: Measured exception for maintainer review; primary regression flag retained.

measuredExceptions.justification: The primary gate has large cold-process spread (candidate capture medians 45–69 ms in most pairs). An equivalent full-engine five-round ABBA after 20 warmups is faster by 17.48%; [INFERENCE] tiering dominates the cold capture, rather than range or result-write overhead.
measuredExceptions.disposition: Measured exception for maintainer review; primary regression flag retained.
